tokens.name: primary-50
tokens.usage: Lightest brand tint. Hover wash on ghost/secondary actions, selected-row background.

tokens.name: primary-100
tokens.usage: Subtle brand fill. Chips, info banners, tag backgrounds.

tokens.name: primary-200
tokens.usage: Brand tint. Dividers inside brand surfaces, disabled primary fill.

tokens.name: primary-300
tokens.usage: Brand tint. Decorative fills, cover tint block.

tokens.name: primary-400
tokens.usage: Light brand. Illustrative accents on light surfaces only, not for text.

tokens.name: primary-500
tokens.usage: Mid brand. Same hue as info; secondary brand accents and hover of lighter fills.

tokens.name: primary-600
tokens.usage: Brand primary. Primary buttons, links, active states, focus rings. Meets 4.5:1 as text on neutral-0/50.

tokens.name: primary-700
tokens.usage: Brand hover/pressed. Hover for primary-600 buttons and links.

tokens.name: primary-800
tokens.usage: Deep brand. Pressed primary on dark, high-emphasis headings over brand tint.

tokens.name: primary-900
tokens.usage: Darkest readable brand. Headings or icons on primary-50/100 surfaces.

tokens.name: primary-950
tokens.usage: Near-black brand. Brand-tinted dark surfaces.

tokens.name: neutral-0
tokens.usage: Card and raised-surface background (bg-card).

tokens.name: neutral-25
tokens.usage: Alternate card / zebra row background.

tokens.name: neutral-50
tokens.usage: Page background (bg-page).

tokens.name: neutral-100
tokens.usage: Borders and dividers on light surfaces (border).

tokens.name: neutral-150
tokens.usage: Stronger divider, input border at rest.

tokens.name: neutral-200
tokens.usage: Control borders, hairline on bg-card.

tokens.name: neutral-300
tokens.usage: Disabled text and disabled control borders.

tokens.name: neutral-400
tokens.usage: Input placeholders (inputs always carry a visible label) and decorative icons. Not for essential text; use neutral-500 or darker.

tokens.name: neutral-500
tokens.usage: Secondary text (text-secondary). Meets 4.5:1 on neutral-0 and neutral-50.

tokens.name: neutral-600
tokens.usage: Body text on tinted surfaces; muted headings.

tokens.name: neutral-700
tokens.usage: High-emphasis secondary text; icons on light surfaces.

tokens.name: neutral-800
tokens.usage: Dark surface panels (one step above ink).

tokens.name: neutral-900
tokens.usage: Brand ink. Primary text (text-primary) and dark surfaces (bg-dark).

tokens.name: neutral-950
tokens.usage: Deepest ink. Footer and full-bleed dark backgrounds.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success state: text, icon, dot, border and solid fill. Meets AA (4.5:1+) on bg-card, bg-page and success-bg; white text on a success fill is AA.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Success banner or badge background. Pair with success or neutral-900 text and a success icon.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning state: text, icon, dot, border and solid fill. Meets AA on bg-card, bg-page and warning-bg; white text on a warning fill is AA.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Warning banner or badge background. Pair with warning or neutral-900 text and a warning icon.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error or destructive state: text, icon, dot, border and fill. Meets AA on bg-card, bg-page and danger-bg; white text on a danger button is AA (5.9:1).

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Error banner or badge background. Pair with danger or neutral-900 text and an error icon.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational state: text, icon, dot and border. Uses the brand blue (primary-600), so always add a text label so it is not mistaken for a link. Meets AA on bg-card, bg-page and info-bg.

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: Info banner or badge background. Pair with info or neutral-900 text and an info icon.

tokens.name: bg-page
tokens.usage: App/page background.

tokens.name: bg-card
tokens.usage: Card, sheet and modal background.

tokens.name: bg-dark
tokens.usage: Dark panels, footers and the brand-blue-alternative dark surface; pair with text-inverse and the light logo.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on bg-page and bg-card.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting and secondary text on bg-page and bg-card.

tokens.name: text-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on bg-dark and on primary-600/700 fills.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and card edges on light surfaces (not a control boundary). For control borders use border-strong.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders: inputs, outline buttons, toggles. Meets 3:1 against bg-card and bg-page (WCAG non-text contrast).

styles.name: display-3xl
styles.usage: Hero and page titles. Plus Jakarta Sans Bold.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary text, form help, table cells.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Labels, badges, metadata. Use with text-secondary.

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: Code, tokens, IDs and figures. JetBrains Mono.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Base unit. Icon-to-label gap, tight inset.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Compact padding, chip inset.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control inner padding, small stack gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default padding and element gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Comfortable padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, section inner gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between grouped blocks.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Large block spacing.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Major section spacing.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Page section rhythm.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Hero and page-top spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small controls, tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and cards (default).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large cards, sheets, modals.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Feature panels and hero containers.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, avatars and the circular logo mark.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting elevation: inputs, flat cards.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Raised cards, dropdown triggers.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Overlays: menus, popovers, modals.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring (primary-600 over a white gap). Apply on :focus-visible.
